what: QUADRO turns the FM-1 into a four-section performance synth after the ARP Quadra: bass, string ensemble, poly and a two-voice lead play at once across a split keyboard, with a 14-stage phaser, reverb and delay, one-finger chords, a clock-synced sequencer and 105 programs.
author: Matt Allison
sounds: own: demo recordings of QUADRO playing on the FM-1
